title: Sturdy!
text: Sturdy!. This is a sturdy melamine tray. It's great for outdoor entertaining. The design is fairly neutral for Vera Bradley! I really like it!

product_metadata.title: Vera Bradley Indoor/Outdoor Melamine Serving Tray Plate
features: BEAUTIFUL & DURABLE -- this beautiful printed melamine tray is made from a durable material that won't shatter like glass - perfect for outside or indoor dining and entertaining
PERFECTLY SIZED -- this tray measures 15 inches in diameter and features two handles - it is the perfect addition to your outdoor barbeque, picnic, or party
CARE -- Dishwaser safe. Do not microwave
GIFT FOR HER - Great gift for the woman in your life for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, & Mother's Day
COMPLETE THE SET -- pairs perfectly with our Vera Bradley Indoor/Outdoor Melamine Dinner Plate and Salad Plate
